title: Beyond Marginal Influence: Interaction-Aware Memory Selection for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.23266v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-agent memory selection often uses retrieval rankings based on record relevance or individual influence. Such rankings cannot identify sufficient subsets under redundant or jointly necessary evidence. We study per-decision memory sufficiency: selecting a small subset that preserves full-memory behavior. To separate search error from model error, we introduce JointCoreBench, a benchmark with nine interaction families, six workflow domains, natural-language decisions, and exact sufficient-set oracles, and JointCore, a relevance cost-ordered group-deletion baseline that tests blocks before individual records. On 6,912 exact conditions, cost-ordered JointCore recovers a minimum-cost sufficient set in 100.0% of cases, reduces subset evaluations from 30.00 to 11.13 (62.9%), and achieves 87.8% active-memory savings. Across four 12B-70B model families and 432 tasks per model, its unweighted mean is 10.28 versus 16.00 model queries and 50.6%

translated_title: 超越边际影响：面向LLM智能体的交互感知记忆选择
translated_abstract: LLM智能体的记忆选择通常使用基于记录相关性或个体影响的检索排序。这种排序在存在冗余证据或联合必要证据时无法识别出充分的子集。我们研究逐决策记忆充分性问题：即选择一个能保持完整记忆行为的小子集。为了将搜索误差与模型误差分离，我们提出了JointCoreBench——一个包含九类交互族、六个工作流领域、自然语言决策以及精确充分集预言的基准测试，并提出了JointCore——一种按相关性成本排序、先测试记录块再测试单条记录的组删除基线方法。在6,912个精确条件下，按成本排序的JointCore在100.0%的情况下恢复了最小成本的充分集，将子集评估次数从30.00降至11.13（降低62.9%），并实现了87.8%的活跃记忆节省。在四个12B-70B模型家族和每个模型432个任务上，其未加权平均值为10.28，对比16.00次模型查询和50.6%。
tldr: 该论文提出JointCoreBench基准和JointCore方法，突破传统基于边际影响的记忆排序方式，通过感知记录间交互并采用成本排序的组删除策略，实现LLM智能体最小成本充分记忆子集的选择，达到100%恢复率并将子集评估次数减少62.9%。
